card.title: One Last Thing
card.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

mechanism: A turns completed cup chores and the waiting taxi into successive tiny reasons for B to remain present.
confusable: Unlike ordinary hospitality, A must extend the chain when B explicitly signals departure.
comparison: D26-b recruits the driver into the delay; D26-a finds another control question after the first fault is explained.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
